title: 1986 AHSME Problem 18
statement: A plane intersects a right circular cylinder of radius \(1\) forming an ellipse. If the major axis of the ellipse is \(50\%\) longer than the minor axis, the length of the major axis is

solutions.text:
The minor axis of an elliptical plane section of a right circular cylinder is a diameter of the cylinder. Its length is therefore \(2.\) The major axis is \(50\%\) longer, so its length is \[ 2+0.50(2)=3. \]

Thus the correct answer is E.
hints: The minor axis of such an elliptical section is a diameter of the cylinder
Increase that diameter by \(50\%\) to obtain the major axis
